_about: Public-domain John Overall (1559-1619), Bishop of Norwich, author of the sacramental part of the Prayer Book catechism, for the Word Hoard: the Convocation Book of 1606, commonly called Bishop Overall's Convocation Book (Library of Anglo-Catholic Theology, Oxford: Parker, 1844), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 41 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

overall-convocation-book-1844: The convocation book of MDCVI ... concerning the government of God's Catholic Church and the kingdom of the whole world (Oxford, Parker, 1844)

_alternates.overall-copies: Sancroft's 1690 first printing and other scans of the 1844 edition

_excluded.overall-other: A Catechism of the Constitution of the United States (1892-1895), by a later Overall
